```{python}
#| label: fig-sequential-dlatch
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "A D latch of NAND gates. The two cross-coupled gates on the right form an SR latch with the active-low inputs $\\overline{S}$ and $\\overline{R}$. The two gates on the left pass `D` to it only while `G` is 1."
#| fig-alt: "Gate-level circuit diagram. On the left, the input D drives the upper input of a NAND gate and, through an inverter, the lower input of a second NAND gate below it. The gate input G drives the lower input of the upper NAND gate and the upper input of the lower NAND gate. The output of the upper gate, S bar, drives the upper input of a third NAND gate, whose output is Q. The output of the lower gate, R bar, drives the lower input of a fourth NAND gate, whose output is Q bar. A dashed box labeled SR latch encloses the third and fourth gate. Q feeds back to the upper input of the fourth gate and Q bar to the lower input of the third gate, and the two feedback wires cross between the gates."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import logic
from schemdraw import elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

RED, GREY = '#b85450', '#666666'
SC = 1.4                     # gate scale: inputs 0.7 apart, 2.59 long
YS = 1.75                    # S bar and R bar wires at +YS and -YS
XD, XG = 0.8, 2.6            # lanes of D and G
XN, XL = 3.2, 7.6            # inputs of the front gates and of the SR latch
XO = XL + 2.59 + 1.2         # end of the output wires
X = 0.5                      # half height of the cross


def text(p, s, halign='center', color='black'):
    ''' Text aligned to p in x, with its capitals centered on p in y '''
    # A free Label sits 0.1 to the right of its anchor with its baseline on it, so shift it back.
    # theta(0): a label inherits the direction of the last wire, and its alignment turns with it.
    elm.Label().theta(0).at((p[0] - 0.1, p[1] - 0.1)).label(s, color=color, halign=halign)


def line(*pts, color='black'):
    for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
        elm.Line().at(a).to(b).color(color)


def dot(p, color='black'):
    elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at(p).color(color)


with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white', margin=0.2)
    # front gates: out at +YS and -YS
    n1 = logic.Nand(inputs=2).right().scale(SC).anchor('out').at((XN + 2.59, YS))
    n2 = logic.Nand(inputs=2).right().scale(SC).anchor('out').at((XN + 2.59, -YS))
    # SR latch: S bar into the upper input of n3, R bar into the lower input of n4
    n3 = logic.Nand(inputs=2).right().scale(SC).anchor('in1').at((XL, YS))
    n4 = logic.Nand(inputs=2).right().scale(SC).anchor('in2').at((XL, -YS))
    line(n1.out, n3.in1)
    line(n2.out, n4.in2)
    xs = (n1.out[0] + XL - 0.7)/2   # between the front gates and the dashed box
    text((xs, YS + 0.3), r'$\overline{S}$')
    text((xs, -YS - 0.3), r'$\overline{R}$')
    # D: to n1 and through the inverter to n2
    text((0.0, n1.in1[1] + 0.3), 'D', halign='left')
    line((0.0, n1.in1[1]), n1.in1)
    dot((XD, n1.in1[1]))
    inv = logic.Not().right().anchor('in1').at((XD + 0.5, n2.in2[1]))
    line((XD, n1.in1[1]), (XD, n2.in2[1]), inv.in1)
    line(inv.out, n2.in2)
    # G: to n1 and n2
    text((0.0, 0.3), 'G', halign='left', color=RED)
    line((0.0, 0.0), (XG, 0.0), color=RED)
    dot((XG, 0.0), color=RED)
    line((XG, 0.0), (XG, n1.in2[1]), n1.in2, color=RED)
    line((XG, 0.0), (XG, n2.in1[1]), n2.in1, color=RED)
    # outputs and the cross: Q to the upper input of n4, Q bar to the lower input of n3
    xq, xl = n3.out[0] + 0.4, XL - 0.4
    line(n3.out, (XO, n3.out[1]))
    line(n4.out, (XO, n4.out[1]))
    text((XO + 0.1, n3.out[1]), 'Q', halign='left')
    text((XO + 0.1, n4.out[1]), r'$\overline{Q}$', halign='left')
    dot((xq, n3.out[1]))
    dot((xq, n4.out[1]))
    line((xq, n3.out[1]), (xq, X), (xl, -X), (xl, n4.in1[1]), n4.in1)
    line((xq, n4.out[1]), (xq, -X), (xl, X), (xl, n3.in2[1]), n3.in2)
    elm.Rect(corner1=(xl - 0.3, YS + 0.75), corner2=(xq + 0.3, -YS - 0.75), lw=1).at((0, 0)).linestyle('--').color(GREY)
    text(((xl + xq)/2, YS + 1.1), 'SR latch', color=GREY)
```
